differential.name: Immune thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP)
differential.rationale: Severe isolated thrombocytopenia (platelets 12 ×10³/µL) following recent viral pharyngitis, with otherwise normal leukocyte and hemoglobin levels.

differential.name: Drug‑induced thrombocytopenia
differential.rationale: Acute drop in platelets could be precipitated by recent medication exposure (e.g., antibiotics, NSAIDs) common in viral illness treatment.

differential.name: Early myelodysplastic syndrome
differential.rationale: Low platelet count with microcytic red cells and borderline anemia in a 37‑year‑old suggests marrow dysplasia rather than isolated immune loss.

differential.name: Acute leukemia (e.g., AML)
differential.rationale: Severe thrombocytopenia can be an initial manifestation; however normal white count and lack of blasts make it less likely than ITP.

differential.name: HIV infection–associated thrombocytopenia
differential.rationale: HIV can cause immune‑mediated platelet destruction; risk heightened by social stressors, but no other supporting labs.
